1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address LIC OF INDIA DIVISIONAL OFFICE, SANJAY PLACE GROUND FLOOR, STATIONERY GODAWN JEEVAN PRAKASH BUILDING AGRA-282002 UTTAR PRADESH . 3. Generic Buyer Organization specific Integrity Pact shall have to be complied by all bidders. Bidders shall have to upload scanned copy of signed integrity pact as per Buyer organizations policy along with bid. Click here to view the file 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Terms & Conditions of the Contract 1. Address for submission: Chairman Stores Committee Office Services Department, LIC of India Divisional Office, Jeevan Prakash Building Agra , 282002 2. The successful bidders shall have to provide security deposit @3% of the contracted value wherever the quantum of total supply is expected to exceed Rs 5,00,000/-. The successful bi dders shall be communicated about their estimated yearly- contracted value at the time of is sue of letter of acceptance of bids and the bidder shall have to deposit the entire amount wit hin 21 days of receipt of the acceptance letter. In case the bidder fails to deposit the same t he amount shall be deducted from the payments due to the vendor, if any. The Security deposit should be deposited in form of Demand Draft/Banker’s Cheque drawn in favor of Life Insurance Corporation of India payable at Agra or through NEFT/RTGS. 3. The stationery and printing thereon should be strictly as per the prescribed norms & standa rds of Life Insurance Corporation of India. The Corporate symbols, Emblem & Logo on variou s formats of stationery should be in strict adherence to the standardized designs prescribed under the Corporate Identity Program (CIP), 2006. The brochure for the same is enclosed her ewith so that the designs and guidelines laid down under CIP, 2006 be followed in letter & sp

irit. 4. No deviation from the CIP norms, on any count whatsoever, will be accepted. The defective material supplied shall have to be replaced by the vendor immediately & free of cost. In case of gross/ repeated violations, the Competent Authority may take appropriate action against t he firm- including the forfeiting of security money and black listing. 5. Paper of the A Grade mill only i.e. Century/ Ballarpur/ Orient/ JK or A grade paper of A grade mill only will be accepted (wherever required). 6. After the approval of proof of draft artwork order may be placed in parts depending upon th erequirements during the year. The material will be delivered at the stores of Statione ry- Office Services Deptt. LIC ofIndia, Divisional Office, Jeevan Prakash Building, S anjay Place, Agra -282002. within the stipulated period as decided at the time ofplacing o rder but not more than 30 days from the date of order. 7. Approval of artwork: The vendor should get the artwork approved from the Corp oration within 7 days of the date of order. If not done within this time limit and if the delay is found to be on the part of the vendor the time period for supply of fin ished material shall start forthwith and penalty clauses shall be applicable as give n below. 8. Penalty Clause: Quality of supply and timely delivery are the essence of this contract. Non- adherence to the instructions shall attract the following penalty. a) Time limit for supply of stationery would be 30 days from the date of receipt of purchase order/ date of approval of artwork, whichever is later (based on clause 7 ab ove). The vendor would be liable to pay penalty after expiry of 30 days from the date of receipt of purchase order/date of approval of art work as tabulated below: SI No. Delay Period (No. of days after expiry of 30 % of the Gross Contract Va days from the date of receipt of purchase o lue rder/ date of approval of art work) 1 Up to 15 Days 1% 2 From 16 Days to 30 Days 3% 3 From 31 Days to 45 days and more 6% On delay beyond 45 days , the order may be cancelled at the discretion of the Sr. Divi sional Manager and the Corporation will then be free to acquire stationery from an alt ernate source. The difference in price of stationery so acquired will then be recovered from the defaulting vendor. Under such a scenario, at the discretion of the Sr. Divisional Manager, the firm may even be blacklisted with forfeiture of the securit y deposit. The above-mentioned penalty clause would also be invoked in case of short supply of

stores. An order once placed shall be honored by the vendor in full. b) Quality Check: The supplied stationery should be on good quality, A grade mill paper only and should confirm to the prescribed GSM as per the specifications. Also, t he paper should be of good brightness, should be of the said color as per the specific ations and should not be dull in appearance. c) For default on GSM parameter: i. A deviation of +/- 4% may be ignored, ii. In case of variation of more than 4% upto 10 %: Penalty Equal to the shor tfall percentage iii. In case a variation of more than 10 %: The entire stock will be returned for replacement without making any payment and totally at the risk & cost of the su pplier. d) In case of variation in size, if +,- 5 % may be allowed in total area. No Deviation in Pr e-Printed Computer Running Stationery is allowed. e) For default on paper quality & appearance: Paper quality should be as per tender co nditions and no deviation from the same will be accepted. Non- compliance of the supplier on any of the penalty clause above would warrant bl acklisting and forfeiture of security deposit as decided by the Competent Authority. 9. This agreement may be terminated forthwith if the bidder firm/company becomes insolvent , ceases its operations, dissolves, files for bankruptcy or bankruptcy protection, appoints rec eivers, or enters into an arrangement for the benefit of creditors, the Corporation shall have the right to immediately terminate this agreement. 10. The Contractor will have no rights to transfer or assign the contract or any rights there under to anyone. 11. If carbon in any batch is found to be misplaced in any way that hampers smooth printing, t he whole lot would be returned to the vendor for replacement at cost & risk of the vendor. 12. Should the stationery delivered contain any folds or be de- shaped, etc. in any way that obs tructs printing, the same shall be returned to the vendor for replacement at cost & risk of the vendor. 13. Termination Clause: The Corporation reserves the right to terminate the contract without assigning any reason by giving a notice of 30 days. This decision will not be challengeable in any court of law. The Contractor will have to give a notice of 30 days if the contractor wishes to terminate the contract before expiry of the contract period. In this case security deposit w ill be forfeited.

14. Any dispute arising out of this acceptance shall be referred to for “Arbitration” to The Sr. Di visional Manager, L.I.C. of India, Divisional Office, Jeevan Prakash Building, Sanjay Place, Agr a -282002 and his decision shall be binding on the Vendor. The Vendor shall not raise any qu estion of the competence of the Sr. Divisional Manager to act as sole arbitrator. Any dispute arising out of or relating to this tender shall be deemed to have arisen in Agra and shall be u nder adjudication a court in Agra. 15. The Competent Authority reserves the right to reject anyone or all the tenders without givin g any reason or notice. Further, the Competent Authority may at its discretion the part or wh ole tender process without assigning any reason whatsoever. 16. Conditional tenders will be rejected out rightly and will not be considered any way. THE INSURANCE LAWS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2015 1. In terms of provisions of Section 33 (3) of The Insurance Laws (Amendment) Act, 2015, Insura nce Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI), is authorized to verify all such boo ks of account, register, other documents and the data base in the custody of the contractor in r espect of service outsourced by the LIC of India. It shall be the duty of the contractor to provid e such documents/statements/information as may be required by IRDAI within such time as m ay be specified by IRDAI. 2. In terms of provisions of Section 33 (4) of The Insurance Laws (Amendment) Act , 2015, Insur ance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI), if it considers expedient to do so, may direct any person hereinafter referred to as “Investigating Officer”, to make an investigati on as specified under Sec.33 (1) or carry out an inspection as specified under Section 33 (2) of the Insurance Laws (Amendment) Act, 2015, who may examine on oath any Manager, Managin g Director or Other Officer of the service provider or contractor where the services are outsour ced by LIC of India. Sr. Divisional Manager .
